text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—So, are you going to use this letter
to ask that girl for a rematch...?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it amazing?! Once they see Turbo's challenge letter,
they'll get all fired up and it's gonna be an awesome race!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, hmm... The kanji might be different, so
maybe the other person... won't get it...?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
My head... hurts...
...Kanji... I can't read this kanji~~...

From using her brain so much,
Twin Turbo ended up with a lingering headache...
